facts.text: Undergraduate students at Bentley take a set of six required Business Dynamics courses that automatically earn them a Business Administration minor upon completion with at least a 2.00 GPA.

sources.title: Degree Requirements | Bentley University Catalogues
sources.quote: All students are automatically be enrolled in the Business Administration Minor, as successful completion of the Business Dynamics courses with a minimum cumulative GPA of 2.00 will result in earning the minor.
